_comment: Simple term -> ICD-code-prefix lookup. Used two ways: (1) the Text-to-SQL agent prompt resolves a clinical term the user typed (e.g. 'sepsis') to icd_code prefixes for a WHERE ... LIKE clause; (2) scripts/ingest_structured.py uses the same prefixes to select which admissions belong to a cohort when carving the subset. Deliberately a flat dict, not a vector index — vocabulary here is small and known in advance.
